product.description:
Day of Trinity — Lansing Lamont

A stated first edition of Lansing Lamont’s account of the Manhattan Project and the first atomic test, published by Atheneum in 1965. Includes the photographed historical illustrations.

Condition

Acceptable, heavily worn ex-library copy. No intact dust jacket; a jacket-blurb clipping is attached to a preliminary page. Cloth boards and spine show substantial fading, soiling, rubbing and fraying, with worn corners and spine ends. The front inner hinge is split/exposed. Library markings include a St. Joseph, Michigan public-library blindstamp, a discard stamp, a spine call number, and handwritten numbers and notes on preliminary pages. Pages show age toning, creased corners and small preliminary-page edge tears. Not inspected page by page; interior completeness and binding strength have not been fully checked. Please review all nine photographs.

Details

  • Title: Day of Trinity
  • Author: Lansing Lamont
  • Publisher: Atheneum, New York
  • 1965; “First Edition” explicitly stated on the copyright page
  • English-language cloth hardcover; manufactured in the United States
  • Approximately 9½ × 6 × 2⅜ inches; book-only weight 1 lb 12.3 oz

Included

One hardcover book with the attached jacket-blurb clipping. No intact dust jacket.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with corner protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
